title: Super Assistant
tagline: Super Assistant revolutionizes data querying for non-technical users by providing a seamless and intuitive interface that harnesses the power of natural language processing, enabling effortless access to data from Tableland and the graph
description: Super Assistant revolutionizes data querying for non-technical users by providing a seamless and intuitive interface that harnesses the power of natural language processing, enabling effortless access to data from Tableland and the graph. By allowing the user to interact with a simple chatbot the experience gets much much better.
how_its_made: I harness the power of ChatGPT to seamlessly transition from a simple prompt to a sophisticated query in GraphQL or SQL. With finesse, I fetch the relevant data from the structured tables or the intricate graph databases. Finally, I elegantly present the insights in our conversation, weaving it all together within a dynamic and intelligent chatbot.
